## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is named `feature/US-xx-short-name` (or `fix/`, `chore/`, `docs/`)
- [ ] Acceptance criteria from the story are met, or the PR says which ones are left
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `npm test` passes locally
- [ ] Money stays in integer cents end to end
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under "Unreleased"
- [ ] A decision that changes the architecture has an ADR in `docs/adr/`
